# @dxtmisha/nitro-basic

> Foundational utility library for building robust Server-Side Rendering (SSR) applications with Vue 3 and Nitro.

Provides unified client and server application bootstrapping, hydration-safe router creation, cookie synchronization, and SSR header propagation for Nitro and H3.

## Key Functions & Modules

- [uiCreateApp](src/functions/uiCreateApp.ts): Unified factory to create Vue application instances for both CSR and SSR.
- [uiBootstrapClient / uiCreateClientApp](src/functions): Client bootstrapping and DOM mounting helpers.
- [uiBootstrapServer / uiCreateServerApp](src/functions): Server request handler rendering Vue SSR markup and headers.
- [uiCreateSsrRouter](src/functions/uiCreateSsrRouter.ts): Router factory choosing between memory history (server) and web history (client).
- [uiCookieStorage / uiServerStorage](src/classes): SSR-safe cookie and request-isolated storage wrappers.
- [initApi / initHeaders](src/functions): Propagates request origin and auth headers to the API client during SSR requests.

## Optional & AI Resources

- [ai-types.md](ai-types.md): Public TypeScript declarations and options interfaces.
- [README.md](README.md): Full SSR architecture guide and code walkthroughs.
